summary: Mineral County, MT lookout near St. Regis: a tower in use by 1927, an L-4 tower dated 1936 by firelookout.com, now gone; no site description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1936 for an L-4 tower. The montanalookouts quotes describe a tower being built in 1921 and a tower in use in 1927. The sources do not reconcile these dates, so the story reports both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 L-4 date from firelookout.com conflicts with the 1921 and 1927 accounts quoted on montanalookouts; neither source explains it, and a replacement tower is not documented in what was read. The 1927 cabin and lightning items are quoted on montanalookouts from a 1927 Helena paper, a 1927 Mineral Independent item and a 1993 memoir (Walt Hahn, Mules and Mountains); the originals were not read. The place name varies: Tamarack point, Tamarac lookout, Tamarack peak. No removal date, no site description and no access source found. The story does not describe the site today.
